findings.finding: Lease validity evaluated before row-lock acquisition can remain true after lock wait exceeds expiry.
findings.reproduction: 500ms lease; independent transaction locks job row; complete begins while lease valid; release row after900ms. Completion accepted after expiry.
findings.impact: Expired worker can persist a reconciliation decision without rechecking the deadline after lock acquisition. No second owner/fence takeover or token movement demonstrated.
findings.remediation: Acquire row lock first, then evaluate expiry with a fresh database clock; preserve worker/fence checks and add lock-contention regression.
